XLAT::listen_lifetime
Description
This iRules command sets/gets the listener lifetime. Valid range is
between 0 and 31536000 (365 days).
Syntax
XLAT
::
listen_lifetime
<
handle
>
[
xlat_lifetime
]
Examples
when
SERVER_CONNECTED
{
set
listener
[
XLAT
::
listen
30
{
proto
[
IP
::
protocol
]
bind
-
allow
[
serverside
{
LINK
::
vlan_id
}]
-
ip
[
serverside
{
IP
::
local_addr
}]
server
[
IP
::
client_addr
]
[expr
[
TCP
::
local_port
]
+
1
]
allow
[
LB
::
server
addr
]
0
}]
log
local0.
"[XLAT::listen_lifetime $listener]"
}

Valid Events:
ANY
